Achha, pehle main dikhati hoon. Cricket pitch ka ek sira 0, doosra 1: batsman run lete hue beech mein ruk gaya. Beech ka mark 0 se ek gap par hai, aur 0 se 1 tak 2 barabar gaps hain: isliye 1/2. Yahan tak saaf hai?
nahi

Ek roti ko theek beech se kaato toh do barabar hisse milte hain. Line par bhi beech wala mark 0 se 1 ko aise hi do barabar gaps mein baant-ta hai, isliye woh 1/2 hai. Ab line 3 barabar gaps mein bhi kati hai. Wahan 0 ke baad pehla mark kaunsa fraction hai?

Rohit

Us line ke gaps ek-ek karke socho: marks ke beech wale bhi, aur 0 ke baad wala aur 1 se pehle wala bhi. 0 aur 1 ke beech 7 marks line ko barabar gaps mein baant-te hon, toh kitne gaps banenge?

director.text: aath gap

Haan, bilkul theek. Marks se gaps ek zyada: 7 marks, 8 gaps. Ab wahi 0 se 1, par line par 8 barabar gaps hain. Gap zyada, toh har gap pehle se chhota hai. Pehla mark 1/8 hai, 0 se ek gap door. Ab wahi 0 se 1, 10 barabar gaps mein bhi kata hai. 0 ke zyada paas kaun rukega: 1/8 ya 1/10?

director.text: 1/10 rukega

Bilkul sahi: jitne zyada gaps, utna chhota har gap: 10 gaps ke saath pehla mark 1/10, 0 ke zyada paas aata hai. Ab ek sawaal milkar, ek-ek kadam karke dekhte hain. Ghar 0 par hai aur school 1 kilometre par. Beech raaste mein 3 bijli ke khambe barabar doori par hain. Board par abhi sirf beech wala khamba hai. 3 khambe raaste ko kitne barabar gaps mein kaatte hain?

seams.form: Ab ek sawaal milkar, ek-ek kadam karke dekhte hain.

director.text: mujhe lagta hai 4

Haan, 4 gap: dono siron par bhi ek-ek gap hai. Doori gaps se naapte hain, khambon se nahi: khamba bas ek jagah hai, aur ghar se pehle khambe tak ka chalna ek gap hai. Tumhari baari: pehla khamba ghar se kitne kilometre par hai?
